current_suggestion.pitch: Curt Jaimungal interviews physicists, philosophers, and AI researchers at a depth that sits between Lex Fridman's breadth and a pure academic seminar — he's unusually willing to press on foundational and philosophical questions rather than just capability demos or career narratives. His physics and consciousness episodes cover territory (integrated information theory, the hard problem, mathematical Platonism) that none of your current channels touch, making him the clearest complement to your Stoicism and mental models interests as they brush against deeper questions about mind and reality. Long-form solo and interview format, typically 2–4 hours, with prepared technical depth.
